spec:
# EXECUTIVE ENGINEERING DIRECTIVE: DIR-009 (UPDATED)
Title: DIR-009: Three Dashboards Flawless 10/10 Polish & Multi-Portal Synchronization (Admin, Enterprise, Employer)
Target Workspace: d:\xampp\htdocs\IME365
Lead: Antigravity (Google DeepMind)
Developer Engine: Cline
Priority: P0

## Objective
Elevate the 3 non-candidate dashboards (Super Admin Console, Enterprise Console, Employer Portal) from 8.4/10 to a verified 10/10 production standard by systematically resolving all identified clipping, layout shifts, route aliasing, dark mode contrast regressions, unsaved states, formula injection risks, and mock data discrepancies.

## Scope & Target Files (Zero Solo Coding on Candidate Dashboard):
1. Super Admin Console:
   - frontend/src/pages/admin/console.tsx: add flex-wrap and shrink-0 to header container.
   - frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUsersTab.tsx: replace overflow-hidden with overflow-x-auto; add dark mode tokens to status badges.
   - frontend/src/components/admin/AdminModerationTab.tsx: replace overflow-hidden with overflow-x-auto on both sub-section tables; add dark mode tokens to badges.
   - frontend/src/components/admin/AdminBlogManagementTab.tsx: replace overflow-hidden with overflow-x-auto; add dark mode tokens.
   - frontend/src/components/admin/AdminDashboardTab.tsx: format KPI metric numbers using .toLocaleString().
   - frontend/src/components/admin/AdminHealthTab.tsx: add dark:ring-emerald-950/60 to health pulse; add title={s.engine} to truncated models.
   - frontend/src/components/admin/AdminQueuesTab.tsx: add dark mode classes to Replay/Purge buttons.
   - frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx: add dark mode classes to status badges and test alerts.
   - frontend/src/components/admin/AdminHelpDeskTab.tsx: add dark mode classes to ticket status badges.
2. Enterprise Console:
   - frontend/src/pages/enterprise/console.tsx: add semantic query and route alias dictionary mapping iam/users -> members, sso/saml/m2m -> security, roles/rbac -> access, quotas/billing -> usage, logs -> audit, tickets -> support, preferences -> settings; add shrink-0 to <Building2> icon.
   - frontend/src/components/enterprise/EnterpriseSettingsTab.tsx: add form submit handler and save action to persist SSO & Authentication Security settings via enterpriseApi.
   - frontend/src/components/enterprise/EnterpriseAuditTab.tsx: add safe formula neutralization (=, +, -, @) to CSV export.
   - frontend/src/components/enterprise/EnterpriseEmailTab.tsx: add input fields to configure sender display name and footer text with save handler.
   - frontend/src/components/enterprise/EnterpriseTeamsTab.tsx, EnterpriseRolesTab.tsx, EnterpriseSecurityTab.tsx: add Escape key listeners to modal dialogs.
3. Employer Portal:
   - frontend/src/pages/employer/portal.tsx: replace overflow-hidden with overflow-x-auto on Candidate Pipeline list table; key candidate messages and metadata by active candidate.
   - frontend/src/components/employer/TeamSeats.tsx: wrap permissions matrix table in overflow-x-auto; bind active user dynamically from useAuth(); add responsive wrapping (flex-col sm:flex-row) to team member rows on mobile.

STRICT EXCLUSION:
Under NO circumstances touch any files under frontend/src/pages/dashboard/* or frontend/src/components/Dashboard/* as remote developer is actively working on them.

## Verification:
- npx tsc -b in frontend/ must pass with 0 errors.
- npm run build in frontend/ must compile cleanly under 3.0s.
- Playwright responsive audit must pass with 0 clipping issues across Mobile (375px), Tablet (768px), and Desktop (1280px).
- Playwright three-dashboard-deep-audit.spec.js passes 3/3.
invariants: ZERO DOUBLE-SHELLING: Admin, Enterprise, and Employer consoles must NEVER render the Candidate Workspace sidebar on their primary navigation rail.
CANONICAL DEEP-LINK INTEGRITY: Direct URLs (/admin/:tab, /employer/:section) must restore the exact target view upon reload.
STRICT RBAC & DATA ISOLATION: Admin routes require ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN; Enterprise enforces X-Tenant-Id; Employer requires authenticated recruiter session.
WCAG 2.1 AA & CUBA M3 SYSTEM: Accessible landmarks, high contrast >= 4.5:1, and consistent glassmorphic styling tokens.
PERFORMANCE BUDGET: Frontend build compiles under 3.0s with zero compilation errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Adaptive Portal Shell or Dedicated Shells: Refactor CubaAppShell or create dedicated shells so Admin (/admin), Employer (/employer), and Enterprise (/org) portals display their authentic navigation rails without candidate sidebar double-shelling.
Restore Global ContextSwitcher in header and user dropdown allowing eligible users to switch between Candidate, Employer, Enterprise, and Admin portals.
Bidirectional Route & URL State Synchronization in router.tsx: /admin/:tab, /employer/:section, and /org/:slug/:tab deep-links load the correct view on reload.
Employer Portal Parity: Add /employer/messages, /employer/jobs, /employer/applicants, /employer/company, and /employer/settings sub-routes with active status.
TypeScript compiler (tsc -b) passes with 0 errors and npm run build compiles cleanly within budget.

steps: 1. 2. Bidirectional Deep-Linking (frontend/src/app/router.tsx): Wire explicit deep-link routes for /admin/:tab, /employer/:section, and /org/:slug/:tab with synchronized URL state restoration on hard refresh.
3. Super Admin Console Polish (frontend/src/pages/admin/console.tsx & Admin Tabs): Add flex-wrap/shrink-0 to console.tsx header

add dark classes to action buttons and badges in AdminQueuesTab.tsx, AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx, and AdminHelpDeskTab.tsx.

add sender name and footer inputs in EnterpriseEmailTab.tsx
attach Escape key listeners to modals in EnterpriseTeamsTab.tsx, EnterpriseRolesTab.tsx, and EnterpriseSecurityTab.tsx.

5. Employer Portal Parity (frontend/src/pages/employer/portal.tsx & TeamSeats.tsx): Add overflow-x-auto to Candidate Pipeline table in portal.tsx, key candidate conversations dynamically by active candidate ID, and support all 7 tabs (/employer, /jobs, /applicants, /messages, /company, /team, /settings)
wrap permissions matrix in overflow-x-auto, bind active user dynamically via useAuth(), and add responsive flex-col sm:flex-row wrapping in TeamSeats.tsx.

6. Verification & Gatekeeper Evidence: Run npx tsc -b in frontend/ (0 errors), npm run build (<3.0s), and execute Playwright tests/three-dashboard-deep-audit.spec.js across Desktop (1280px), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (375px) viewports with zero regressions.
